Kuvalaa
poet. Gāthāsaptaśati III. 82 (a.. in Weber's edn.).

Kuvalaya,_mālava
poet. Q. by Kṣemendra in his Aucityavicāracarcā, 26.

Kuvalayamālā
Jain. unspecified; probably by Udyotanasūri. See below. Ahmedabad 4864 (20). Chani 1224. 1759. 3401. Jainagranthāvalī p. 250. JBhP. I. 637.

Kuvalayamālākathā
Jain. Pkt. Composed in 779 A. D. a. Jhālor (Jābālipura) in Marwar in the time of King Vatsarāja of the Pratihāras, by ‘Dākṣiṇya-cinha’ Udyotanasūri, son of Vaṭeśvara or Saṁprati an. pupil of Haribhadra an. Nemicandra.
Bombay 1879-82, p. 12. BORI. 154 of 1881-82. D. p. 207. Jainagranthāvalī p.. 222. 250. 251. Jesalmere p. 27. Skt. Intro. p.. 42-3. Rep. Raj. & C. I. p. 28 (a. Haribhadra wrong).
Indrasūri, a. of Kuvalayamālā in Peters. V. p. 73 an. Jainagranthāvalī (reproduced in NCC. II. 225b) is a mistake for Dākṣiṇya-cinhasūri, the title of Uddyotanasūri.
Ed. A. N. Upadhye, Singhi Jain Ser. 45. 1959.
See NCC. II. p. 337b; Apabhraṁśakāvyatrayī, GOS. 37, Skt. Intro. p.. 89-94, 104-110. ABORI. XVI. p.. 34-35; Jaina Sid. Bhās. XVI. i. p. 25; Kapadia, Canonical Lit. of the Jainas p. 196; Bhāratīya Vidyā II. i. p.. 77-80. On its Pkt. portion, see Ind.-Iranian Journal I. p.. 229-240. For ‘An unpublished fragment of Paiśācī’ from it, see Alfred Master, BSOAS. XII. iii-iv; for ‘Gleanings from it’, see A. Master, BSOAS. XIII. iv. On ‘Skt. [Page249-b] passages in Ku.’, ‘Language an. dialect used in the Ku.’ an. ‘Works an. a.s ref. to in Ku. of Uddyotanasūri’, see A. N. Upadhye, Adyar Library Bulletin XXV (1961) p.. 353-59 an. Summaries of Papers to AIOC. XXII. Gauhati Session. Jan. 1965. p.. 131-2, 149. On ‘Influence of Vimalasūri's Paumacariya an. Bāṇa's Kādambarī on Ku. of Uddyotanasūri’, see P. M. Upadhye, J. of Ori. Inst., M. S. Uni. Baroda XVI. iv. June 1967. p.. 371-4.

Kuvalayamālākathā
Jain. Skt. version of the above composed in 1431 A. D. by Ratnaprabha, pupil of Paramānanda.
AK. 1327. BORI. 1327 of 1891-95. Jainagranthāvalī p.. 222. 250. JBhP. I. 636.
Pt.. (1) Ātmānanda Jainagranthamālā 54. 1916. (2) A. N. Upadhye, Siṅghi Jain Ser. 45-a. 1961.

Kuvalayavatī_nāṭikā
in 4 Acts. by Kṛṣṇa kaviśekhara. IO. 4184.

Kuvalayavilāsa
nāṭaka in five Acts. by Rāyasa Ahobila mantrin, son of Rāyasa Nṛsiṁhāmātya, written a. the instance of Śrīraṅgarāya (1571-85 A. D.), son of Tirumalarāya of Vijayanagar.
MT. 2319. 5056. See NCC. I. p. 357a.

Kuvalayavilāsa
or Madālasācampū. by Trivikrama Bhaṭṭa, son of Nemāditya.
Pt.. Kāvyetihāsasaṅgraha. iii. Pt. 1-6. 1882.
See Madālasācampū.

Kuvalayānandakhaṇḍana
also called Alaṁkārasthiti (see NCC. I. p. 299a) an. ‘Ekaṣaṣṭyalaṁkāraprakāśa’ (see NCC. III. p. 55b). by Bhīmasena Dīkṣita, of Kanauj; son of Śivānanda an. grandson of Muralī- [Page254-a. dhara; composed a. Jodhpur while Ajitasiṁha was reigning (1680-1725 A. D.). a. adverse criticism of Kuvalayānanda; based on the expositions of Devanātha, Govinda, Jayarāma an. others.

D. an. the further Acts, completed in Benares in 1783 [Page254-b] A. D. on the prompting of Śubhanātha Miśra, a. ardent student of vyākaraṇa.

Kuvalayāśvacarita
kāvya, illustrating steadfast love, on the story of Kuvalayāśva (Ṛtudhvaja) an. Madālasā. Q. by Bhoja. See V. Raghavan, Bhoja's Śṛṅgāra Prakāśa (1963) p.. 773, 797.
